name: session-flow
description: Hermes Desktop plugin — smooth line-by-line chat animation, Ctrl+Scroll session cycling, Firefox-style session tab groups, glass readability for chips and the input field, and sidebar-style content tabs. Live-configurable settings page included. Two builds: SDK-only catalog build (plugin.js) and full standalone build (full/plugin.js).
author: AGANTILA — Deniz Yilmaz (https://agantila.com), contact: info@agantila.com

scripts.test: node tests/render-test.mjs full && node tests/render-test.mjs catalog
